fit_sentence: LearnToSAP SD tutorial walks the reader through S/4HANA Cloud SD 150+ SPRO configuration nodes with natural-language prompts: sales org -> distribution channel -> pricing procedure -> output determination -> partner functions, as a module-learning prompt workflow for the unfamiliar-module task.
deliverable_artifact: Prompt templates per config chain (enterprise structure assignments, pricing, output, partners), dependency check descriptions, and prerequisite-required sequencing notes; all usable as a module-learning SOP copy-paste.
resource_type_reason: A standalone, long-form 2026-27 tutorial article; not a tool.
why_recommended: 以 SD 150+ SPRO 节点为例，按配置链给自然语言提示词模板、依赖顺序与前提检查；适用 S/4HANA Cloud，事务执行类动作需对应 OData 已启用。

material_claims.claim: Joule availability: S/4HANA Cloud (not on-prem ECC)
Joule navigates to the correct SPRO path and opens the config screen
Joule validates and saves the configuration automatically
material_claims.note: Transactional save depends on specific OData backend being active, which the SAP ref arch does not assert as globally enabled for every SPRO node; scope mismatch marked non_critical and written in why_recommended.
